fields.location: Route 4 north of Bel Ravi, Karun Province
fields.summary: A Harbourlight Relief vehicle carrying two staff was stopped at an unofficial checkpoint. The staff were held for about three hours and then released without injury. The vehicle and the relief items were returned. The staff report that no reason was given.
fields.injuries: No injuries. Both staff were met by a colleague and are resting at the country office.
actionsTaken: Movements on Route 4 north of Bel Ravi stopped pending review.
informed: Security focal points of other agencies (alert SA-2026-017)
nextSteps: Review the corridor risk assessment on 16 October.
Debrief both staff with a staff care adviser.
